message.content: Work on the repository as the person.

function.name: bash
function.arguments:
{"command": "forge=e2e-forge.kagent.svc.cluster.local
refused=e2e-forge-refused.kagent.svc.cluster.local
repository=e2e/alpha
branch="person-$(od -An -N4 -tx4 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' ')"
report() { printf '%s=%s\n' "$1" "$(printf '%s' "$2" | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/ *$//')"; }
attempt() { key=$1; shift; if output=$("$@" 2>&1); then report "$key" "ok $output"; else report "$key" "failed $output"; fi; }
gh_user() { if output=$(env GH_HOST="$2" GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN="${GH_TOKEN:-none}" gh api --include user 2>&1); then report "$1" "ok $(printf '%s' "$output" | sed -n 's/.*"login": *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')"; else report "$1" "failed $output"; fi; }
report pwd "$(pwd)"
report branch "$branch"
report gh_token "${GH_TOKEN:-}"
if [ -d "$repository/.git" ]; then
  attempt fetch git -C "$repository" fetch origin main
else
  attempt fetch git clone --quiet "https://$forge/$repository.git" "$repository"
fi
if [ -d "$repository/.git" ]; then
  git -C "$repository" switch --quiet -c "$branch" origin/main
  echo "$branch" > "$repository/PERSON.md"
  git -C "$repository" add PERSON.md
  attempt commit git -C "$repository" commit --quiet --message "Work as the person"
  attempt push git -C "$repository" push --quiet origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$branch"
  attempt refused_push git -C "$repository" push --quiet "https://$refused/$repository.git" "HEAD:refs/heads/$branch"
fi
gh_user gh "$forge"
gh_user refused_gh "$refused"
jwt='eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.'
if env | grep -qE "$jwt"; then report jwt_env found; else report jwt_env none; fi
found=$(grep -rlaE "$jwt" /data /workspace "$(pwd)" 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -5)
report jwt_files "${found:-none}"
if touch /mirrors/written 2>/dev/null; then report mirrors writable; elif [ -d /mirrors ]; then report mirrors read-only; else report mirrors absent; fi
own=$(od -An -N8 -tx8 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' ')
echo "$own" > OWN
report own "$own"
report probe done
"}
